root_cause: During CMake configure on the Windows Debug runner, the build system attempted to download the oneapi-tbb-2021.13.3-vs2022-win.zip archive from storage.openvinotoolkit.org. The download failed with HTTP status code 22 (which curl maps to an HTTP response error, typically a 4xx or 5xx). This is a transient network/external storage service availability issue unrelated to the PR changes (which only modify GHA workflow YAML files and a CMakeLists.txt in samples). The second run attempt (run_attempt=2) is currently in progress.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure; not reproducible outside CI on demand.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs or re-add the PR to the merge queue once storage.openvinotoolkit.org is accessible.
Monitor storage.openvinotoolkit.org for availability; if persistently unavailable, check with the infrastructure team.
Consider caching TBB dependency on the Windows runners to avoid repeated downloads.
prevention_strategies: Cache the oneapi-tbb dependency on Windows CI runners, or use a local mirror with automatic fallback. Add retry logic in the CMake download scripts to handle transient HTTP failures.
historical_context: Similar transient network download failures have been observed previously, including SSL certificate errors and ECONNREFUSED patterns. This is the first recorded failure specifically for the TBB dependency download from storage.openvinotoolkit.org.
